module: Editor preferences registry: organizes preferences as category > subcategory > item (path "category.subcategory.item"), with type, default value, description, label, bounds, hidden/advanced flags, custom UI function, enum labels and version. Handles loading/saving in `settings/editor/preferences.json` (format version 2, only values differing from the default are written) and emission of the `onEditorPreferenceValueChanged` hook. Editor extensions declare their settings there; it is also accessed via `editor.getPreference(path)`. The module returns a constructor with no arguments.
usage:
local reg = require("editor/api/preferencesRegistry")()
reg:registerCategory("myTool", "My Tool")
reg:registerSubCategory("myTool", "general", "General", {
  {speed = {"float", 1.0, "Speed", nil, 0, 10}},
})
reg:loadPreferences()
local v = reg:get("myTool.general.speed")
notes: Format of an item in registerPreferences (positional table): [1] type, [2] defaultValue, [3] description, [4] label (otherwise sentenceCase of the name), [5] minValue, [6] maxValue, [7] hidden, [8] advanced, [9] customUiFunc, [10] enumLabels (list of strings, generated enum {name, value=index}), [11] version (default 0). Each element of `prefs` is a table with ONE single {name = infos} pair to keep the order.
Types handled for string (de)serialization: float, int, double, char, bool, table (JSON), Point3F/vec3, Point2F, Point2I, Point4F, ColorI, ColorF, RectF. Vectors are written without commas.

`set` clamps numbers between minValue and maxValue and marks `dirty`; an unregistered path is logged once then ignored. `get` crashes if `loadPreferences` has not been called yet (self.preferences nil).
Changes are accumulated in `changedItems` and broadcast by `broadcastPreferenceValueChanged` (to be called from the editor loop), not immediately.
If the file has a format version other than 2, it is ignored (default values) and overwritten at the next save.

Emitted hooks: onEditorPreferenceValueChanged(itemPath, value), onEditorPreferenceVersionChanged(itemPath, fileValue, item), onEditorDeprecatedPreferencesItem(itemPath, value) (returning true deletes the item).
`getAsString` and `resetItemToDefault` crash if the path is not registered (item nil).
`loadCategory` crashes if the file contains an unregistered item (findItem returns nil then itemValueFromString(nil, ...)).

C.desc: Registry object. Fields: categories, nonPersistentItemPaths, preferences (current values per category), changedItems, dirty.

init.desc: Calls clear(). Called by the constructor.

clear.desc: Clears categories, non-persistent paths, preferences and changed items, and resets dirty to false.

itemValueFromString.desc: Converts a text value (read from the file) into a Lua value according to item.type (number, bool, JSON table, vec3, Point2F, ColorF...).

itemValueToString.desc: Converts a value to text for the file: tostring for numbers/bool, JSON for table (unchanged if already a string), tostring without commas for vectors/colors.

registerCategory.desc: Creates (or finds) a top-level category. If it exists with a different label, warns and replaces the label.

categLabel.desc: displayed label (default sentenceCase of the name)

registerSubCategory.desc: Creates (or finds) a subcategory in an already registered category and optionally registers preferences in it. Logs an error and returns nil if the category does not exist.

registerPreferences.desc: Adds items to an existing subcategory. A name already present is refused with a logged error.

prefs.desc: list of one-pair tables {name = {type, default, description, label, min, max, hidden, advanced, customUiFunc, enumLabels, version}}

addNonPersistentItemPath.desc: Marks a path as non-persistent: it is not written to the preferences files.

subCategoryPath.desc: full path of the item (despite the parameter name)

removeNonPersistentItemPath.desc: Removes a path from the non-persistent list.

findCategory.desc: Looks up a category by name.

findSubCategory.desc: Looks up a subcategory by name in a category.

findItem.desc: Looks up an item by path "cat.subcat.item"; nil if fewer than 3 segments or not found.

findItemInSubCategory.desc: Looks up an item by name in a subcategory.

migratePreferences.desc: Walks the loaded preferences and, for each item absent from the registry, emits onEditorDeprecatedPreferencesItem; deletes the item if deleteDeprecatedItems is true or if the hook returns true. Also fixes categories/subcategories that are not tables.

set.desc: Sets the value of a preference by path (clamped for a number), marks dirty and queues the change for the hook.

broadcastPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Emits onEditorPreferenceValueChanged for each queued change then clears the queue.

get.desc: Returns the value of a preference by path (equivalent of editor.getPreference).

getAsString.desc: Returns the value of a preference serialized as text according to its type.

loadPreferences.desc: Reads the preferences file (default settings/editor/preferences.json), rejects a different format version, then fills each registered item with the file value or the default value. Handles old (non-table) values and calls onEditorPreferenceVersionChanged if an item's version changed. No change hook during loading.

callHookForSetValue.desc: Emits onEditorPreferenceValueChanged for ALL registered items with their current value (useful after a load).

loadCategory.desc: Loads a single category from a file in saveCategory's format and applies its values; marks dirty.

saveCategory.desc: Saves all the preferences of a category (even those at the default value, excluding non-persistent paths) to a json file.

savePreferences.desc: Writes the preferences to the file (default settings/editor/preferences.json) omitting values equal to the default and non-persistent paths; resets dirty to false. Keeps values of unloaded extensions.

returns.desc: false if no preferences are loaded

resetToDefaults.desc: Resets all the items of a category, or of all categories if categoryName is nil, to their default value.

returns.desc: false if the category does not exist

resetItemToDefault.desc: Resets an item to its default value.
